rationale: A tagging slip in this filing: four positions have their units or principal on the position context and their cost and fair value on the following context under the issuer-name axis. The extractor reads values from the position context only, so the rows had no fair value and were not published. Each added row takes its quantity from the position context and its cost and fair value from the cited value context; classification is copied from the same identifier's row in the nearest quarter. Pinned to the quarter because it repairs one filing; the durable fix is in the extractor (read a position's values from an issuer-axis context when the position context has none). Authored in an interactive session and checked by fund-sandbox reconciliation, not by the fleet promotion gate.
